title: Brauer and iquantum categorification
summary: We show that locally finite Abelian module categories over the affine Brauer category are the same thing as locally finite Abelian 2-representations of a certain 2-iquantum group satisfying some additional nilpotency and finiteness properties. Our results are valid over algebraically closed fields of characteristic other than 2 and for arbitrary spectra. This extends recent work of Gao, Rui and Song, who treated characteristic 0 with half-integral spectrum.
